purpose: Document first-party local registry/search evidence and HM Land Registry parcel-source access review without claiming a successful geometry integration.

discovery.english: HM Land Registry INSPIRE Index Polygons guidance and the current Use land and property data download catalogue were found; the catalogue lists Cardiff Council as a local-authority GML area. Cardiff Council's own Local Land Charges page identifies the Council as custodian of the register and links an online mapping tool for personal searches.
discovery.welsh: Welsh-language discovery query was executed; it did not reveal a separate open Cardiff cadastral geometry service. Cardiff Council's bilingual site and the national HM Land Registry source remain the evidenced routes.
discovery.scope: Cardiff Council is a local registry/search custodian. HM Land Registry is the national England-and-Wales parcel-data custodian. General Welsh spatial-data catalogue pages were treated as contextual, not as proof of cadastral parcels.

requestOutcomes.outcome: Official guidance states INSPIRE Index Polygons cover England and Wales, show indicative freehold registered-property extents, and provide unique Land Registry-INSPIRE IDs; it directs users to the Use land and property data service.

requestOutcomes.status: HTTP 302 repeated self-redirect; fetch not completed
requestOutcomes.outcome: The current official catalogue was visible in search results and lists Cardiff Council as a downloadable local-authority GML area. Direct anonymous GET from the research environment returned repeated Location: /datasets/inspire/download redirects, so no Cardiff GML bytes, current JavaScript/configuration, schema, CRS, or parcel response was retained.

Cardiff Council states it is responsible for the Local Land Charges Register and provides an online mapping tool for personal searches; the page separately directs ownership questions to HM Land Registry. No parcel-feature API was evidenced on this page.
Official Cardiff Council My Cardiff map entry point was found. It is an address/local-information map and was not treated as a cadastral geometry endpoint.
Welsh Government DataMapWales was checked as a general spatial-data catalogue; no Cardiff cadastral parcel layer was confirmed in this attempt.
Official API information says API access requires account/licence/API-key steps for listed datasets; no account, credential, private token, or authenticated request was attempted.

queryParameters.pointUse: Preserved exactly; no coordinate shift and no exact-point hit/miss inference.
queryParameters.reason: The public catalogue route was blocked by a self-redirect loop before a downloadable Cardiff file or service query could be inspected.

nativeFieldMapping.candidateNativeIdentity: INSPIRE_ID / Land Registry-INSPIRE ID, as documented by HM Land Registry
nativeFieldMapping.retainedProperties: No GeoJSON sample retained because no native geometry response was obtained.
nativeFieldMapping.compositeKeyProvenance: No composite key used; no parcel record was retrieved.

scopeLimits: Catalogue listing and national guidance demonstrate source availability in principle, not successful Cardiff geometry retrieval.
Cardiff Council local land charges/search evidence is not equivalent to an open cadastral parcel API.
No exact-point hit or miss, map extent miss, timeout, redirect, or unusable UI was used as evidence of citywide absence.
No unsafe fields were requested or retained.
No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS exception was used.
reviewDisposition: Packet research is complete with uncertainty recorded; source integration/admission is not claimed and serial reviewer qualification remains required.
